description: This Java class 'DefaultMessageMapperFactory' is responsible for instantiating MessageMapper objects within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically in the connectivity mapping service. It manages loading mapper classes, creating instances via dynamic access, and configuring mappers with provided options. It also handles extension loading and maintains a registry of payload mappers.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperFactory
classes.description: Final class responsible for creating and configuring MessageMapper instances, managing payload mappers, extensions, and dynamic class instantiation within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity mapping context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new DefaultMessageMapperFactory instance with provided connection ID, actor system, mapping config, and log adapter.

methods.name: mapperOf
methods.description: Creates and configures a MessageMapper based on the given mapper ID and mapping context.

methods.name: registryOf
methods.description: Builds a MessageMapperRegistry with default, connection-specific, and fallback mappers based on payload definitions.

methods.name: createMessageMapperInstance
methods.description: Instantiates a MessageMapper for a specified mapping engine using dynamic class loading and applies extensions.

methods.name: createAnyMessageMapper
methods.description: Creates a MessageMapper instance from a class using dynamic access, handling common instantiation errors.

methods.name: configureInstance
methods.description: Configures a MessageMapper with provided options, handling invalid configuration exceptions.
